name: The Forgotten Ossuary
subtitle: A sealed crypt beneath the old frontier road, where every detour asks what you are willing to risk.

rooms.name: Ossuary Gate
rooms.description: A stone stair descends beneath weathered memorial arches. The Guild seal on the door is centuries old.

rooms.name: Bone Gallery
rooms.description: Dry bones scrape across the flagstones as an old guardian pulls itself together.

rooms.name: Grave Offerings
rooms.description: A row of intact offering bowls survived the centuries.

rooms.name: Forked Crypt
rooms.description: Two passages split beneath a cracked funerary seal. One is warded and quiet; the other promises richer grave goods behind a dangerous breach.

options.label: Take the Warded Stair
options.description: Follow the intact funerary wards and conserve strength for the chambers ahead.

options.label: Break the Reliquary Seal
options.description: Force open the sealed side chamber. The backlash hurts, but the old offerings are still inside.

rooms.name: Falling Vault
rooms.description: The ceiling gives way as the passage narrows.

rooms.name: The Knight's Vigil
rooms.description: An armored keeper rises from a throne of cracked marble and draws a rust-dark blade.

rooms.name: Crystal Font
rooms.description: A small crystal spring still glows beneath the crypt, offering one quiet moment before the final chamber.

rooms.name: Sealed Belfry
rooms.description: Stone wings unfold above the burial bell. The Ossuary's final sentinel has been waiting for a challenger.

name: The Emberglass Foundry
subtitle: A ruined mountain forge where crystal furnaces still burn beneath the Ashen Highlands.

rooms.name: Foundry Gate
rooms.description: Heat rolls through a broken mountain gate. The old furnaces beyond still pulse with a dull orange glow.

rooms.name: Slag Vats
rooms.description: A living mass of furnace slag peels itself from the cooling trench and blocks the gantry.

rooms.name: Foreman’s Cache
rooms.description: A locked shift chest survived beneath a collapsed workbench.

rooms.name: The Furnace Split
rooms.description: The main gallery divides around the furnace core. The cooling galleries are safer; the forge heart is shorter, hotter, and richer.

options.label: Take the Cooling Galleries
options.description: Circle the furnace through the old coolant channels and recover in the cooler air.

options.label: Cross the Forge Heart
options.description: Cut directly across the live furnace floor and salvage what the workers abandoned.

rooms.name: Slag Chute
rooms.description: A cracked sluice suddenly vents molten debris across the only remaining walkway.

rooms.name: Buried Pit
rooms.description: The foundry floor collapses into an old ore pit. Something enormous has made the rubble its nest.

rooms.name: Engineer’s Font
rooms.description: A maintenance crystal still feeds clean aether into a sheltered alcove beneath the master forge.

rooms.name: Master Crucible
rooms.description: An Inferno Drake coils around the master crucible, feeding on the furnace flame that has burned here for generations.

name: The Whiteglass Bastion
subtitle: A half-buried northern fortress where whiteout winds, frozen wards, and an old Behemoth have turned every surviving route into a test of endurance.

rooms.name: Snowbound Gate
rooms.description: A black-stone gate rises from the drift. The old watch fires are dead, but the ward crystals buried in the arch still pulse beneath the ice.

rooms.name: Frozen Barracks
rooms.description: A Chimera prowls between collapsed bunks and frozen weapon racks, driven inside by the storm.

rooms.name: Quartermaster Icebox
rooms.description: The quartermaster stores froze before they could be looted. Some of the emergency supplies are still intact.

rooms.name: Shattered Rampart
rooms.description: The inner wall has split. A sheltered gallery winds beneath the rampart, while the exposed battlement offers faster access to untouched stores through brutal wind.

options.label: Take the Sheltered Gallery
options.description: Use the lower corridor, conserve resources, and let the old wardstones blunt the next environmental hazard.

options.label: Cross the Exposed Battlement
options.description: Fight through the whiteout to reach abandoned stores. The exposure hurts and strengthens the next foe, but the route promises a richer combat haul.

rooms.name: Whiteout Causeway
rooms.description: The fortress causeway disappears beneath a sudden wall of snow and cutting ice.

rooms.name: The Iron Watch
rooms.description: An Iron Giant frozen upright beside the command hall tears free of the ice and resumes a patrol that should have ended generations ago.

rooms.name: Command Crossroads
rooms.description: Two sealed command routes remain. The signal tower offers intelligence and a safer final approach; the war room vault promises preserved stores behind unstable wards.

options.label: Climb the Signal Tower
options.description: Study the old patrol charts and mark the guardian’s approach before entering the heart of the Bastion.

options.label: Breach the Sealed War Room
options.description: Break the command vault wards for preserved Guild-era stores, accepting backlash and a harder final fight for a greater combat payout.

rooms.name: Hearth Crystal
rooms.description: A fortress hearth crystal still glows beneath layers of frost, creating one pocket of warmth before the sealed command sanctum.

rooms.name: Bastion Heart
rooms.description: A Behemoth has claimed the command sanctum as its den. Frost coats its mane and every broken standard bends toward it in the gale.

name: The Riftglass Observatory
subtitle: A shattered observatory anchored above the Astral Scar, where broken lenses turn every chamber into a gamble with the rift.

rooms.name: Scar Threshold
rooms.description: The observatory hangs over violet nothingness. Fractured brass rings turn in the dark without wind or machinery.

rooms.name: Watcher Gallery
rooms.description: An Evil Eye drifts between cracked star charts, tracking every movement through a dozen reflected lenses.

rooms.name: Unstable Lens Array
rooms.description: Three damaged lenses flare at once, each catching a different possible future.

outcomes.label: The lenses stabilize
outcomes.description: The alignment settles into a protective pattern and the next passage becomes easier to read.

outcomes.label: The array overloads
outcomes.description: The surge burns, but the released aether condenses into useful battle insight.

outcomes.label: A rift echo answers
outcomes.description: A second image of the chamber overlaps reality, leaving behind a crystallized fragment before it collapses.

rooms.name: Astronomers' Lockbox
rooms.description: A counterweighted vault opens beneath the charting floor.

rooms.name: Broken Orrery
rooms.description: The main orrery is split around a rotating void seam. A service ring is stable but slow; the central bridge crosses the anomaly directly.

options.label: Take the Service Ring
options.description: Follow the intact outer machinery, reinforce the ward lattice, and conserve strength.

options.label: Cross the Rift Bridge
options.description: Take the exposed central bridge and harvest the raw crystal growths clinging to its frame.

rooms.name: Gravity Well
rooms.description: The floor lurches sideways as a local gravity seam snaps across the corridor.

rooms.name: Clockwork Aperture
mechanics: Armored aperture: Protect for the opening 2 rounds
Pressure clock: defeat it within 10 rounds
rooms.description: A Death Machine unfolds from the observatory's shutter mechanism, shielding its core behind rotating plates.

rooms.name: Starwell
rooms.description: A basin of cold starlight gathers beneath the dome, quiet enough to restore breath and focus.

rooms.name: Shattered Dome
rooms.description: The final dome is open to the Scar. You can recalibrate the surviving seals or force the aperture wider and draw power from the breach.

options.label: Recalibrate the Seals
options.description: Use the observatory's surviving ward geometry to weaken whatever waits beyond.

options.label: Force the Aperture
options.description: Open the breach wider. The backlash is immediate, but the final confrontation will yield richer spoils.

rooms.name: Riftglass Crown
mechanics: Aperture drain: lose 12% max MP/AP on entry
rooms.description: A Crystal Wolf steps from the broken lens crown, its body splitting into prismatic afterimages as the observatory begins to collapse.
